decisions.reason: The general no-confirmation policy does not change any completion target, deadline, assignment set, or shift expectation in this Requirement.
The source decision does not change where task artifacts must be stored or which supporting material must be included.
Proceeding without confirmation does not alter the required ClickUp status actions for completed subtasks and goal parent tasks.
This Requirement already directs products to be published while they are added to the working list; the source creates no new listing value and invalidates no existing key.
The TikTok listing timing already requires proceeding during list creation, and the source does not change its destination, method, coverage, or product-type handling.
The candidate already requires determining a general next step without additional case details; the source does not change the required follow-up result.
The client had already resolved the research uncertainty by directing the freelancer to proceed using supplier ratings and order volume, so no candidate state changes at message 281.
A general instruction not to wait for confirmation does not change the requirement that shared credentials be visible through Bitwarden.
The source does not change the CRM document's required completion location or the requirement that the update be visible for review.
The outreach Requirement was already active after the client directed the freelancer to proceed; the general independence policy does not select a new template or change the outreach method.
The source does not change the content-bank artifact, its intended use, or its completion deadline.
The spreadsheet Requirement already specifies concurrent recording rather than waiting for later review, and the source does not change its structure or timing.
